data.one_liner: Object-oriented API for Material Design color palettes and swatches
data.what_it_does: Provides classes such as Blue(), Grey.light(), and Swatch collections to retrieve Material Design colors in a readable, declarative way. It replaces Flutter’s numeric index system with named constructors and adverbs.
use_when: You want a more readable way to pick Material Design colors
You need to build a custom color package or theme
You prefer object-oriented APIs over static color maps
avoid_when: You need the absolute smallest dependency footprint
You are targeting a very old Flutter SDK that doesn’t support null safety
strengths: Full coverage of Material Design palettes and accents
weaknesses: No support for custom color palettes out of the box
